result.brief: 提出面向多模态生理信号（PPG/ECG/EEG/EMG）的统一共享编码器，结合跨模态对齐、随机特征预测与掩码波形重建，实现可复用的生理表征。
result.reason: Unified physiological signal representation learning with cross-modal alignment and random-feature prediction; no video/visual representation or world-model contribution, only loosely transferable self-supervised ideas.
